plugins.name: dev-team
plugins.description: Crew: a team runtime — a whole team booted per task, with deterministic code running the loop (plan, gate-first acceptance, build, review, suite, commit-on-green) and agents kept for judgment via closed-enum decision envelopes. Two modes on one backbone: interactive cmux panes, or headless workers owned by a daemon and driven from factoryctl.
